whereabouts: At nine, Lina was present when the master had everyone show their watches
After dinner, Lina went up to the atelier
In the atelier, Lina worked beside the master at his bench
When the hall clock struck ten, Lina was in the atelier with the master
The master sent Lina downstairs when the regulator showed 10:20
Lina went straight down to the kitchen after leaving the atelier
That afternoon, the master was in the kitchen
When the piano began, Lina was in the kitchen with Rosa
When the piano stopped, Lina was in the kitchen with Rosa
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven
